original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-finite-module-over-finite-extension}
Let $R \to S$ be a finite ring map.
Let $M$ be an $S$-module.
Then $M$ is finite as an $R$-module if and only if $M$ is finite
as an $S$-module.
